title: Books
description: Public library of stories, picture books and novels, published at https://JorgeGarciaIrazabal.github.io/books/

provenance.note: Download files are byte-for-byte copies of the selected export artifacts. Cover images are derived from the published editions as noted per book. This file stays in the repository and is not copied into the website; tools/build_catalog.py projects only the public fields into _site/catalog.json.

books.title: The Ledger of Ashes
books.summary: In 1752, goblin accountant Ragna finds a false charge on the day Ministry officials seize the iron ledger holding her community's wages. Her search for the missing iron exposes a transaction that powerful goblins and Ministry officials want buried, and forces her to choose between saving the ledger and publishing the proof. First book of The Goblin Wars; unofficial Wizarding World fan fiction, 22 chapters.
books.edition_note: Public fan-fiction reading edition: 22 chapters, 248 PDF pages; reflowable EPUB 3 with linked contents and a title-page cover.

cover.derived_from: EPUB/cover.jpg inside the published EPUB, a 720x1080 title-page rendering

books.title: The Quest of the Golden Garbanzo
books.summary: A fun, dramatic, easy-to-read adventure about how ordinary humans Jorge, Marissa, and six-year-old Clara braved late-night spreadsheets, a confetti-blasting desk-bot, sneaky Spanish house pitches, and one last office bonus to earn sunny mornings together in Spain. Ten chapters, illustrated.
books.edition_note: Illustrated family adventure reading edition: 10 chapters, 8 interior illustrations, illustrated cover, 36 PDF pages; reflowable EPUB 3 with linked contents and companion 10-chapter Fish Audio Drama 3 audiobook.

cover.derived_from: EPUB/cover.jpg inside the published EPUB, a 720x1080 illustrated cover composited from assets/illustrations/cover-art.png

books.title: The Hot Potato of Corporate Castle
books.summary: Prologue preview of a satirical corporate fantasy set between the pastel Tower of Vibes, austere Liability Tower, and the underfunded ER Watch. When High Lady Lexi vanishes overnight, Lord Sterling kicks the ER Watch across the moat without a single gold coin, leaving Royal Inquisitor Marissa and Captain Sarai to move their crew onto an abandoned wooden barge outside Liability Tower's drawbridge.
books.edition_note: Prologue preview edition (work in progress): Prologue only, 4 PDF pages; reflowable EPUB 3 with typographic cover.

cover.derived_from: EPUB/cover.jpg inside the published EPUB, a 720x1080 typographic cover

books.title: The Three Paths
books.summary: Eleven-year-old Clara steps through a hidden waterfall into Glassvale Academy, where students train across the Path of Makers, the Path of Nature, and the wild Path of Pure Magic. With her friends Maya and Sam, she must earn the trust of skeptical teachers and unite all three Paths to stop a masked intruder hunting a piece of the ancient World-Glass. First book of Beyond the Waterfall; nine illustrated chapters.
books.edition_note: Illustrated reading edition: 9 chapters, 12 interior illustrations, illustrated cover, 47 blended-text PDF pages; reflowable EPUB 3 with linked contents and companion 9-chapter Fish Audio Drama 3 audiobook.

cover.derived_from: EPUB/images/cover.jpg inside the published EPUB, a 720x1080 illustrated cover composited from assets/illustrations/cover-art.png
